parameters: The door is closed and locked.  A sign on the door says:
"Town elder's house.  No visitors without appointment, please."
You see a man you don't know admiring and tending to the flowers of one of the bushes out front of the building.
He turns to you and your friends as you walk by.
"Ah!  Visitors to our town!  I heard there were six newcomers around town, and they might be just the group of heros we need
"I'm the town elder.  I'm in charge of this town, and we could use a group of heros to solve a problem that threatens ALL towns
and ALL lands of every continent of the world, actually."
"It turns out that underneath this island and the entire ocean, lies a massive pool of magma, which one day shall erupt in a gigantic
supervolcano that will eventually cover the lands and oceans of this world with molten lava and block out the sun with smoke, which of
course means the end of everything for all people and all life as we know it, and not just this island."
"Prophecy has forspoken about a group of heros who would one day show up somehow and put a stop to the supervolcano, when it is about to
"It is said that where the heros come from, there are zarakite dragons that build shelters and entire cities that can shield large
populations of life from everything from supervolcanos to asteroid strikes, but here in our world we really don't have any of that,
although we do have a few rare zarakites and half dragons who live here among us humans."
"Okay, why does this seem like a big setup for a plot for a big quest that Benny Zinkland wants us to complete before we get to go home from
So where do we get started?  Any idea where we should go or what to look for?"
"Seek the shrine of The Wise Guy Who Knows Stuff.  He has very powerful divination magic and can read the future.  If anyone can guide
you, he can.  His shrine is somewhere to the east of these mountains, and a little northward.
"You should try to find The Wise Guy Who Knows Stuff.  He can point you in the right direction and tell you where to go next."
You see a dragon-white skinned boy with violet hair, about 12 to 14 years old, playing with a basketball on the pavement.
He has human-looking eyes.  With this combination of features, this boy is either a common human that happens to have dragon-white
skin, which happens sometimes in today's day and age, or a half dragon child like yourself.
He turns to you, and looks you up and down, thinking about something to do with you for a moment.
"Hey mister, you look like a guy in a photograph that someone showed me in their wallet - Some girl who said her name was Alice
showed me a picture and was asking everyone in town if they'd seen you or not.  She said you're her brother."
"You look just like her brother in the photo even with your head cut off.  She said you fight reckless and fight all-offense
and no-defense and so you get your head cut off all the time by monsters and bad guys you fight."
"Yeah, Alice is my sister.  Is she here?  Do you know if she's still in town, or where she is?"
"Nah, she left town.  She said she went to look for you."
"Did she say where she was going?"
"We've had a lot of earthquakes lately, lots more than in past years.  Over the last few months, a great number.
I think the nearby volcano has something to do with it."
"This entire land is on top of a supervolcano waiting to erupt one day, a huge pool of underground magma beneath the planet's
crust.  When it finally erupts one day, we're all dead.
I'm sorry to say it looks a lot like that day is right around the corner now."
"This is the only major town on this entire, large island.  To the north is another large island, with a town in the center.
There's also two smaller islands nearby, one to the south and a little west of this town, with a dangerous cave filled with monsters,
and another to the northwest of the big island north of this one, with sand and palm trees."
"To the east, past the mountains and on the south edge of the harbor, right before a group of mountains and then the ocean, is
a castle owned by a self-appointed 'Duke' of sorts.  Quite a nasty man, I'll tell you.
He doesn't have enough to take over this town, but he's dangerous.  Avoid his castle!"
"It would be nice if we didn't have to worry about all of these earthquakes and the supervolcano.  This really could be the
end of everything, and there are times when I wish the earthquakes would die down so we could live our lives without worry,
but other times where I look at the facts and just don't want to think about it or whether or not my kids will ever have a
chance to grow up and have lives that aren't cut short by the end of everything."
"I heard from everyone all over that the supervolcano is gonna wipe us all out soon.  Are we all gonna die?  'Cuz I don't
wanna sound like a paranoid nut, but I wanna have a life and grow up some day!"
The child is obviously worried.  You can tell it keeps him up at night.  It seems to be making him so preoccupied with worry
that he doesn't even notice or react to the fact that your head is cut off.
